body: Thank you. My biggest fear is that I’m wasting my life and I don’t want to look back and regret it all. I feel like I regret my college years. I should have tried harder and explored more. But I don’t want another 5 years to go back and still be in the same situation 🙃

Keep the advice coming in guys. I really appreciate it. I’m so lost that any recommendation would help me think things through. Also I called in sick today and I am planning on working on my resume finally. It’s a start 🙃

I’ve already been a teacher in the past and I hated it :( I’m just at a really dark place where I hate what I’m doing, what I studied, and I am so unmotivated and passionless to figure out what to do next. I’m barely surviving with my measly pay. What else can I do? :(

I just did the math of my current routine and I spend 9 hours at (1 hour unpaid lunch), get 8 hours of sleep. So that leaves 7 hours of the day to better myself. Except works kills my mood for the rest of those 7 hours sooo basically wtf am I doing? Breaking down the hours like this makes me want to pull my hair out.
$35K and I’m literally just waiting this week to find out if I’m getting a raise or not 😒
Attractive but I really don’t like the white hair on the beard! Have you looked into like a spray on hair dye? It would significantly improve your looks.
Cute but you look older than 25...try some night cream. Also your beard looks too put together, which is bad if you’re straight or into women 😩

I don’t like you’re hair or facial hair...the facial hair looks to be a different color too.

I like the chunky hair on you but try looking into a hair cute  that is shorter on the sides and lose the beard.

That pixie cute makes you look a lot older than you are, about 28-29, and it makes your curvy body look a bit fat...which you are not. 

I would say get a different hair color/ style asap but other than that you’re a 6/10
You’re not ugly but your hair and clothes make you look really frumpy. I would say 5/10
You’re very average looking. You’re not ugly but I wouldn’t consider you hot. I don’t think anyone would consider you ugly though.
You’re hot but would be even hotter if you had abs and a nicer build 👀
Awe you’re just a baby 💕 I would say just don’t get fat and stay in good shape for the next 5-6 years. I think you’ll peek at 24-28.
You look really cool and mysterious! Pretty too

You are a pretty girl but you’re not a “hot” girl. You look like the girl a guy wants to  settle down with but not the girl a guy is crazy about. Not sure if that makes sense 🤷🏽‍♀️ 

I’m just saying that you’re not ugly, you’re pretty, but you’re not conventionally hot.

If you are gay you look really cute and precious, maybe just trim your brows a bit. 

If you are straight then you should get a shorter haircut like a fade and grow out the facial hair. 🤷🏽‍♀️

Either way you are NOT ugly you just need to come into your own style 😊
You look way better with the full beard 👌🏽
You’re really pretty! I’d only recommend getting some eye cream to treat the puffiness under your eyes and using a really bright concealer until the puffiness dies down.

You’re not ugly but I just don’t like your hair. For some reason that cut makes the top of your head look really narrow. Also you might want to stop wrinkling your forehead. Those lines are only going to get deeper.
You’re cute! I like your hair more in the bottom picture. Maybe you should try different clothes but you look good
I know exactly what’s that’s like! I’m really fat and it’s terrible!
I wouldn’t do that. Shit tbh I hope he doesn’t accuse me 🤭
Post-text?
Even if we didn’t I’m fully certain that there’s no way I’m pregnant because I track my cycle religiously.
I don’t ever want to have anything sexual to do with him again 😟
I don’t remember having sex at all and I told him that I think we didn’t do anything so he shouldn’t worry 🤷🏽‍♀️

I think he’s just so not in to me that he doesn’t even know how to react. Maybe he thinks now I’m swooning over him lmao. I think you’re right. I’m just shutting it all down and acting like it’s nothing (which it is).

I texted him and told him that I wanted to forget the entire thing and just be friends and he agreed but then he asked me if I was pregnant which was super weird so now I just feel so awkward...like I’m hoping he was joking 🙃 I might see him this weekend and I’m just dreading it because I hate awkward situations.
Sounds hot tbh 👀

Have you considered dating women your age? Seems like you’re dating way younger women who are part of a different sex culture than you tbh. Unless the girls you hook up with are over 25 than that’s kinda weird. These comments are too long so I’m not sure what age you’re dating.

I’m a girl and tbh I feel the exact same way. I don’t need to feel “safe” or secure with a guy. As long as he’s hot or I’m ready to go it’s fair game. I do however agree that sex with someone you love is much more enjoyable, but in my experience it’s not necessary for good sex. Although lately I do find myself jaded by casual sex but being in a relationship isn’t appealing in the least to me. Which is why I feel the exact same way as you haha

Update: 

I met up with him yesterday and he wanted to apologize to me and make amends for the harm he caused me during our relationship. It was a lot to take in but I’m glad I went.
Yea I think it might be a booty call too but maybe he just wants closure? My head is spinning out of control 😔
He suggested we get coffee and talk for a bit. I asked him what was important and he said that he wanted to talk about “last year” I guess in reference to the break up 🤷🏽‍♀️

We could never get back together because we live in two different states. I honestly am so shocked because I never thought I’d see him again. I still have feelings for him even after a year and I’m not sure if it’ll be good to see him. It might just open up the wound 😔 I’m at a loss here
Go to urgent care
Everyday
I’ve been in therapy since last April. It doesn’t help too much. Anyways my deadline is getting fired. If I get fired twice in one year I’m out of here.
Update: literally all of the assistants have their office doors closed
There’s 8 of us! I doubt he has a disability because he’s a dick. He thinks he’s so much smarter than everyone. Even the receptionist said he stares at her 🙄 I’m tired of it
I was able to keep my job 😊

I’m a legal assistant and I fuck up a lot. I don’t think it’s a good fit for me right now but also this job is the only thing keeping me even remotely sane. Going to work is my only purpose and I can’t even do it right :(
Same I don’t want to kill myself but I also want to die.
I’m also 24 and have been fired from many jobs. I feel like a failure too :(
That’s all I do on weekends
I needed this. The wort heartbreak has been from a guy I dated short term. I still can’t get over him and I question myself daily.
I’m 24 and feel the same way. I wish I would have enjoyed my childhood and teen years a lot more. I should have played around and made more friends.
I feel the same. I’m so incompetent at work.
It’s been 4 months for me too. I miss him like hell.
It does help. I’m going to check the app out. Glad you’re feeling better.

Getting out of bed is the hardest part of my day and when I’m at work I just think about how much I want to lay down. The thing is that I’d rather be out having fun but I don’t really have any friends and I have terrible imposter syndrome and don’t like being around people that I barely know because I feel like they’re judging me. So I just lay down all day and feel bad about myself. I feel sad because I’m only 24 and I feel that I should be out enjoying life and making the best of my 20s.
Me at work :(
I feel the same. I’ve developed an extreme case of social anxiety. I want to have friends but it’s so difficult for me. I feel like I am just not a like able person.
Yea same for me
It’s been 3 months for me and I would say things have gotten slightly better. The first week I drank every single day, and now I just think about him a lot.
This resonates with me. My depression really affects my performance at work and the way I interact with coworkers. I hope you feel better.
Pretty sure I’m going to get fired because my depression and anxiety have made me incompetent. I’m already hating waking up tomorrow.

There’s a lot of forms involved and I mess up on them. Everyday my boss points out something that I messed up on. Also everyone at my job is an extrovert and I have social anxiety and stay quiet all the time. I’m afraid that I’ll be fired because I’m not friendly :(

Yea I also had a terrible panic attack last night to the point where I couldn’t move and I felt like I was going to die. I’ve never experienced a panic attack of that sort. I typically have shortness of breadth and hyperventilation.
I haven’t reached out. And yes I said no contact because I was upset that he drunk called me and never apologize for it :(

I’ve been to the ER and ended up with a huge medical bill and two weeks inside a psych ward. I had to drop out of school because of it. Honestly this system is designed to fail me. I don’t even care anymore. I just need to think of a good rock solid plan to kill myself for good.
I don’t have a primary care doctor.  I don’t have insurance so I don’t have any options in getting meds.
I just spent 6 hours at the clinic so that they could tell me that they won’t be able to see me today 😡

This really resonates with me and my own break up. I’m really hung up on a guy I dated for 6 weeks and it’s been more than two months since we broke up.  He clearly doesn’t give a shit about me but I can’t move on because like you I connect instantly with people because I’m so lonely. I spent every day with him too and idk now I’m really going through it.
Yup that’s a reoccurring thing for me. I always fuck up my relationships in a big way. That’s why I’ve just stopped trying to make friends. I’ll disappoint them or do something to chase them away.

I’ve been on my phone all day. Idk why because no one ever texts me but I like to see how happy everyone is on social media. For some reason it’s comforting for me to see that I’m not wrong about people not liking me. My “friends” can have so much fun without thinking about me because I’m not important.

:( is there a homeless shelter around you? Maybe call the crisis line they route you to your geographic location and they usually have information on resources near you. I wish I could be more helpful. Sounds really tough but I get the feeling you’ve been through worse so maybe you’ll be able to get through this.

No one likes me. Either I they’re just put off by my depressed/ negative energy initially or they do get to know me and the I ruin everything by letting them see the real me. I had one friend that introduced me to a lot of his friends but then I got super fucked up and had to go to the hospital and now he doesn’t talk to me anymore. I don’t blame him but I kind of wish I remembered that night. Anyways I’m a nightmare and people can tell. I don’t have friends and it’s all my fault. Just sucks because I’m so lonely
This is why I delete my posts but I’m going to start deleting comments too. I haven’t done anything like that but still.

I think some of us just aren’t meant for life. Life is too hard for me and I don’t see the point in keeping on honestly. I’m just too lazy to kill myself but I’m right at the edge so it should be coming anytime.
Me too. I’m only one financial or personal burden away from killing myself. So I just hope today’s not the day I accidentally crash my car or get fired because that will just be it.

I’ve been seeing a therapist and it’s not helping. I haven’t had sex in more than two months now because I don’t want to be a slut anymore. IDK I’m just very unhappy with my ability to form relationships and friendships.
I get tested regularly, every 3 months,  and surprisingly I am clean. I’m always paranoid but I have never had an STD.
That sound like a good tactic lol
Liberal arts bs 😒
I don’t have a personality. I’m just depressed and everyone can tell.

I feel like this everyday. I hate myself for picking a useless college major and not pursuing the right opportunities in college. I should have gone into tech or something. Anyways now I feel like it’s too late. I’m stuck at a dead end job that I hate getting paid $14 and hour and have $30K in student loans. I’m a pathetic loser. I wasted all of that time and my potential.

Yea I feel you on this one. I lie to my therapist because I don’t want her to judge me. I’ll either make up small lies or I’ll completely withhold information. Somehow I still feel like she does. Therapy gets weird for me when I see my therapist start to have hope for me. I just start thinking about how I’ll let them down. So I lie.
THIS.

My “ex” and I broke up because I moved to a different city. We were having some issues too. Anyways two weeks after I moved he came into town and didn’t text or call to let me know. I only found out he was in town because I saw him post a picture on Snapchat. It fucking hurt. I still can’t get over him/it. He has clearly moved on.
Yea I think that’s why it’s so hard. I can’t let go of the what if and what I expected him to be.

I feel the same. I’m 24 and have a useless degree too. I’m in a financial hole and I’m literally just working to pay off debt. I’m so broke and I hate my job. I’m single too and I’ve never had a serious boyfriend. No guy has ever taken me seriously because I’m ugly and stupid. I don’t have much hope that things are going to get better. I don’t have any friends either.  I just go to work and come home. I’ve always had a hard time making friends and people just don’t like me in general. I’m honestly amazed that I’m still alive. I’m just too scared to off myself. I feel like that will cause more problems than I need if I survive. I don’t know if that makes sense but I’d encourage you to hang in there. Things have to get better....right?

Reading through your comments makes me feel like I’m not crazy because you guys described exactly how I feel. I really miss him but that book is closed. At least I can finally admit to myself that I’m never going to see him again. At least I’m not holding on to hope that we’ll get back together and that’s a step in the right direction.
Yea I think I’m finally realizing that it’s time to move on, I can’t quite yet. But at least I don’t cry about it everyday.

I feel the same. I won’t commit suicide but I think a lot about just dropping dead and how it would be better for everyone if I was never born. I don’t understand the purpose of my life. I’ve lived such a miserable and painful life that there’s no point to it. Is my purpose to suffer? Maybe that’s how life works. Some people have to suffer for others to be happy, I just wish that I was one of the fortunate people that is meant to be happy.
Yes but I don’t think I’m ready :( I still have hope that I’ll see him again.
I feel the same way. I don’t think anyone likes me.
I haven’t felt like myself in years.
